proposed_separate_version.name: matched-n sensitivity v2
proposed_separate_version.seed_policy: Choose and record a new seed explicitly; original seed unknown
proposed_separate_version.resampling: Draw six n labels with replacement from the six observed labels, use the same draw for every treatment, and retain all accepted observations in each sampled block.
proposed_separate_version.estimand: Median of concatenated observations; retain unequal block sizes, not mean of block medians.
proposed_separate_version.delta_SSE: median_SSE_treatment - median_SSE_M0 in each shared replicate
proposed_separate_version.reduction_percent: 100 * (1 - median_SSE_treatment / median_SSE_M0) in each shared replicate
proposed_separate_version.interval: 2.5th/97.5th percentiles, linear quantile interpolation, explicitly labeled sensitivity intervals
proposed_separate_version.requirements: Review whether n-level matching is scientifically meaningful; otherwise retain descriptive per-n contrasts without bootstrap intervals. Do not label as original reproduction, independent experimental CI, or multiplicity-adjusted significance.
